info.name: Base Service
info.description:
Test collection for the Base Service (`services/base-service`).

Base no longer runs on mocks: reinforcing asks World Service whether the room is unlocked, reinforcing and upgrading spend the player's resources in Resource Service, and Kiki grants its reward through Player Service - all through the Gateway. The whole stack therefore has to be running (`docker compose up -d` in the CPR).

Run the folders top to bottom (or use the Collection Runner). **Setup** registers a player and gives it resources, **Bases > Create Base** creates a base whose ids the later requests use, and **Cleanup** deletes everything the run created.

Variables: `baseUrl` is Base Service itself (`http://localhost:5076`); `gatewayUrl` is the Gateway (`http://localhost:8000`), used for the requests that belong to other services. `baseUrl` can be pointed at the Gateway too - every request then goes through it - except that **Status** will fail, because the Gateway answers `/api/status` itself.
